ItemID: NA; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Orange PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My projects involve electronics prototyping, and I have no established need for 3D printer filament.
ItemID: NA; Title: 3-IN-ONE Multi-Purpose Oil, 8 OZ; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Potentially useful for maintenance, but I do not have a specific lubrication job right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: USB Endoscope, DEPSTECH 2 in 1 Semi-Rigid Borescope Inspection Camera 2.0MP CMOS HD Waterproof Snake Camera with 6 Adjustable Led for Android, Windows & MacBook OS Computer- 16.4 ft(5M); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An inspection camera is interesting, but it does not directly support my usual circuit-building projects.
ItemID: NA; Title: SUNLU 3D Printer Filament, Neatly Wound PLA Meta Filament 1.75mm, Toughness, Highly Fluid, Fast Printing for 3D Printer, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.02 mm (2.2lbs), 330 Meters, 1 KG Spool, Sky Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have not shown a need for 3D printing supplies, so I would skip this spool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Digital Photo Laser Tachometer Non Contact Tach RPM Meter; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use practical measurement tools, but I have no current project requiring rotational speed measurements.
ItemID: NA; Title: Kreg SML-C125-500 Zinc Pocket-Hole Screws, 1 1/4 Inch #8 Coarse Thread, Maxi-Loc Head (500 Count); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A large supply of pocket-hole screws does not fit my electronics-focused projects.
ItemID: NA; Title: 560PCS Heat Shrink Tubing 2:1, Eventronic Electrical Wire Cable Wrap Assortment Electric Insulation Heat Shrink Tube Kit with Box(5 colors/12 Sizes); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to insulate soldered connections on battery holders, relay modules, and other small circuits.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nut & Bolt Thread Checker (Inch & Metric), Original Version (SWTC-26), Stainless Steel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Occasionally useful for hardware work, but identifying threads is not a recurring need in my history.
ItemID: NA; Title: ELEGOO 32 Pcs Double Sided PCB Board Prototype Kit for DIY Soldering with 5 Sizes Compatible with Arduino Kits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose these boards to turn breadboard experiments into soldered circuits; they closely match my previous prototyping purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla Black Duct Tape, 1.88" x 35 yd, Black, (Bulk Pack of 18); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Eighteen rolls exceed my likely household project needs, and duct tape is not suitable insulation for my circuit connections.
